entities.name: NAD(P)H-hydrate repair enzyme
observations: 494-aa query sequence; predicted molecular mass 50.94 kDa and pI 6.11.
Best reviewed homologs support bifunctional NAD(P)HX epimerase and ADP-dependent NAD(P)HX dehydratase activity; strongest match 45.0% identity over 97.8% query coverage.
Homolog annotations indicate potassium binding; actual query activity and cofactor binding are not experimentally confirmed.
